title: Avoiding every dyadic affine sequence in a large-measure set
exact_target: For every $\eta\in(0,1)$, does some compact $E\subset[0,1]$ of Lebesgue measure greater than $1-\eta$ avoid containing $\{a+b2^{-n}:n\geq1\}$ for every real $a$ and every nonzero real $b$?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
